milestone: M49 Headless Mode Pack Update Drive

answers.strategic_capabilities: headless_autonomous_development with supporting mode_pack_runtime, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: Public run-control can bootstrap registry selection into selected-candidate fetch and fail closed on missing subordinate routed evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Continuation-only registry selection and M49.1 fetch-route execution do not prove public run-control bootstrap or missing-evidence replay rejection.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Scheduled callers keep owning route glue and corrupted routed fetch evidence can still appear replayable.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M48.1 continuation selection and M49.1 already-routed selected-candidate fetch execution.
answers.no_new_rpc: No new RPC is needed; existing headless.run.* surfaces are extended with bounded target data.
answers.no_new_summary: No new summary surface is needed.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Run-control validates and forwards registry-selection targets and rejects missing subordinate routed evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Keeps Mode Pack route sequencing under Rust-owned durable session authority.
answers.milestone_progress: Provides the route-bootstrap and replay-integrity base for the remaining M49 update drive.

exit_criteria: public run-control registry selection target reaches existing continuation authority
selected-candidate fetch replay fails closed when subordinate evidence is missing
